notes: Implemented packages/tools/query-string-parser/ with the standard 6-file structure plus Tool.module.css (7 files, all within allowed paths).

parse strips one leading ?, splits on &, splits each segment on the first =, strictly percent-decodes key and value (malformed % is a visible error; URLSearchParams was not usable because it silently replaces malformed sequences with U+FFFD instead of erroring). serialize always emits key=value joined by &, preserving order and duplicates; lone surrogates are caught and reported.
Copy in parse mode copies the canonical re-serialized query string; serialize mode copies the serialized output.

Two fixes during the session were in my own tests/UI code, not the domain logic: (1) round-trip test used a bare 'd' segment which cannot round-trip identically since parse collapses 'd' and 'd=' to ['d',''] while serialize always writes key=value; (2) the Mode select lacked an aria-label for getByLabelText.
